subject.title: Preserve aborted sessions across restart opt-in

question: Should OpenClaw accept `session.restartContinuation` as a core session config contract after the branch is rebased onto the current done-row reuse behavior?
rationale: The remaining choice is not just code mechanics: this PR adds a new config surface and changes session-id reuse semantics, while current main already fixed the successful done-row rollover slice.

options.title: Require Rebased Opt-In Proof
options.body: Ask for a rebase that updates stale done-row tests and proves the opt-in only for states current main still guards before deciding product acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor The Opt-In Contract
options.body: Keep this PR path open if maintainers want an explicit `session.restartContinuation` knob for narrow aborted-session continuity.

options.title: Close In Favor Of Existing Recovery Work
options.body: Close this PR if current done-row reuse plus broader restart-recovery work make another core session config option undesirable.

recommendation.title: Require Rebased Opt-In Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a rebase that updates stale done-row tests and proves the opt-in only for states current main still guards before deciding product acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history signal around the transcript freshness guard and adjacent session/Gateway behavior.
